verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents first-party integrations for Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono and 20+ more frameworks, plus server-side `auth.api` methods for authenticating users. Users report consistent behavior across frameworks and an easy Next.js-to-Hono migration. However, the pack never documents route-protecting middleware or session verification at the edge, so only the framework-SDK half of the story is shown. The JWT/JWKS plugin is only a building block for edge verification, not the capability itself. Missing for 10: documented route-protection middleware (e.g. a Next.js middleware helper), edge-runtime session verification, and hands-on corroboration of protecting routes.
